list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Mononuclear half-sandwich complex in which the amino-functionalized cyclopentadienyl ligand coordinates in an η5/κ1 mode and two allyl ligands bind in π-η3 modes.

synthesis.procedure: Route A: in a glovebox, LiCp^NMe2 was suspended in toluene and added to LnCl3(THF)x in toluene. After 4 h, C3H5MgCl in THF was added and the mixture was stirred for 16 h at ambient temperature. Solvent evaporation, redissolution in toluene, centrifugation and filtration to remove LiCl/MgCl2, concentration, layering with n-hexane, and storage at -35 °C afforded crystalline 1a; repeated recrystallization from saturated n-hexane at -35 °C was used for purification.
synthesis.temperature: ambient temperature; crystallization and recrystallization at -35 °C
synthesis.time: 4 h initial metathesis, followed by 16 h allyl reaction
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: LiCl and MgCl2 were removed by centrifugation and filtration; solution was concentrated, layered with n-hexane, and cooled to -35 °C.
synthesis.yield: 319 mg, 0.88 mmol, 88% (Route A); alternatively 102 mg, 0.28 mmol, 85% (Route B)

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Dimeric complex with two bridging chlorido ligands. Each Nd center bears an η5/κ1-bound Cp^NMe2 ligand and one π-η3 allyl ligand; the Nd coordination geometry is described as distorted trigonal bipyramidal.

synthesis.procedure: In Route A, LiCp^NMe2 was reacted with NdCl3(THF)1.75 in toluene, followed by C3H5MgCl in THF. After salt metathesis and workup, concentration, n-hexane layering, and cooling to -35 °C afforded green crystals of 2 containing one toluene molecule in the unit cell.
synthesis.time: 4 h initial metathesis, followed by 16 h allyl reaction
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After evaporation and redissolution, LiCl and MgCl2 were removed by centrifugation and filtration; the solution was concentrated, layered with n-hexane, and cooled to -35 °C.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Hexanuclear cluster with a chairlike [Y6Cl12] core, described as two distorted [Y3Cl5] hexagonal-bipyramidal units linked by two additional bridging chlorido ligands. Each trimeric unit contains three μ2- and two μ3-chlorido ligands; two Cp^NMe2 ligands are associated with triethylaluminum and the remaining Cp^NMe2 ligands retain η5/κ1 coordination to yttrium.

synthesis.procedure: Et2AlCl was diluted in C6D6 and added to a solution of complex 1a in C6D6. The mixture was charged with pentane by vapor diffusion at ambient temperature until small crystals appeared, then stored at -35 °C for several days to grow crystals of 3a.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Pentane was introduced by vapor diffusion until small crystals appeared; the solution was then cooled to -35 °C.

Each trimeric unit contains three μ2- and two μ3-chlorido ligands; four Cp^NMe2 groups coordinate η5 to Ho with dangling amino groups bound to triethylaluminum, while two Cp^NMe2 groups retain η5/κ1 chelation to Ho.

synthesis.procedure: Et2AlCl was diluted in C6D6 and added to a solution of complex 1b in C6D6. The mixture was charged with pentane by vapor diffusion at ambient temperature until small crystals appeared, then stored at -35 °C for several days to grow crystals of 3b.
